features.f: Tall triangular cat ears standing up on top of the head, furred in the hair colour with a pink inner ear, and a long slender furred cat tail in the same colour (some tail options end in a bushy, dark-tufted or contrasting-coloured tip). Slim, petite human build with a soft heart-shaped face, big cat-like eyes and tiny fangs, often with thin whisker-like stripe markings slanting across the cheeks.
features.m: The same tall furred cat ears on top of the head and long slender hair-coloured cat tail, on a lean, lithe, wiry build that is slighter than other races' men. Angular youthful face with a narrow chin, sharp cat-like eyes and small fangs, often with a thin dark curved stripe marking under each eye.

f.desc: A strapless black leather bandeau top with a white upper trim held up by brown leather shoulder straps, leaving the midriff bare, with a thin brown strap slung across the body to a small brown hip pouch; detached white puffed sleeves laced with red cross-stitches and banded with brown leather at the upper arm and wrist. Below, a short pleated red skirt under a black belt with a silver buckle, black thigh-high stockings with white tops, and black cuffed ankle boots.

m.desc: A black leather vest with silver clasps over a white short-sleeved shirt with a tall open collar, a brown leather strap slung across the chest, and a studded black belt with a short dark flap hanging at the front; dark leather arm guards with silver plates at the shoulders and elbows. Below, baggy white knee-length zouave trousers cinched with black thigh straps and silver buckles, tucked into tall black knee boots with folded tops.

notes: Data from XIVAPI v2: CharaMakeType rows 12 (Seeker m), 13 (Seeker f), 14 (Keeper m), 15 (Keeper f); Gender 0 = male. Hairstyle menu = Lobby 234; both clans have the identical list in the identical order, so it is given once per gender (no clan-only extras). The creator list is 47 male / 52 female: the race's own styles (male FeatureID 1-12; female 1-12 plus 51-55, which are variants: 51-53 recolour the cord of style 1, 54 is style 4 with gold cuffs, 55 is style 8 centre-parted) plus 35 shared styles (FeatureID 102-178). All 99 have IsPurchasable=false and UnlockLink=0 in CharaMakeCustomize, whereas the aesthetician-only styles (HairMakeType row 12 lists 96) are IsPurchasable=true with a 'Modern Aesthetics' unlock item, so every listed style is free at creation. If you want parity with a Lalafell set built only from race-own styles (1-13, 51-53), the Miqo'te race-own subset is m01-m12 and f01-f17. featureId/customizeRow/icon are extra keys for traceability. Shared FeatureIDs are not the same cut across genders below ~121 (e.g. 103 is a high ponytail for women, a fluffy mop for men). Icons render hair grey, so accessories close to grey are uncertain: m09 bead colour and m21 clip colour are guesses (grey/silver); f05/f22 hairbands read as white, f14 cuffs as silver, f10-f13 cords as gold/green/purple/pale blue. Attire = racial gear from the Race sheet (RSEM*/RSEF*), whose models (131160 m / 131161 f) match CharaMakeType Equipment set 0, i.e. the creator's default outfit; same for both clans; described from ffxivcollection renders and the item icons. Heights are the 0%/50%/100% creator values from the consolegameswiki Races table; scale = typical / 90 cm as asked (the game's 50% Lalafell is 92 cm, which would give 1.70 f / 1.81 m). Skins: creator palette (interface half of human.cmp) via xivdyetools' skin_colors.json; the creator grid is 8 columns (light to dark) x 24 rows. Seekers run warm peach to deep brown; Keepers run pale ivory through ash grey and slate blue-grey to grey-brown. Tails: 8 shapes per clan/gender (plain, dark lion-like tuft, bushy, and tipped variants). Keeper women get an Ear Clasps option instead of Tattoos. Slit vs round pupils (Seekers vs Keepers) is lore only, not seen in the icons, so it is left out of the features text.
